Title: Jeremiah's Yoke and Hananiah
KeyPersons: Jeremiah; Hananiah, the False Prophet; Zedekiah, King of Judah
Events: Jeremiah wears a wooden yoke as a sign that Judah must submit to Babylon, and when the prophet Hananiah breaks the yoke and promises freedom within two years, Jeremiah replaces it with a yoke of iron and announces Hananiah's death within the year.
